name: Rikket Nails
source_profile: ● Rikket Nails (CG) is a young mining foreman who organizes workers against exploitative contracts and unsafe conditions. His growing popularity threatens several established merchant families.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 51 (source excerpt; may be partial)
